mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_user_roles (user_id, role_id, assigned_at) VALUES (#{id.userId}, #{id.roleId}, #{assignedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT ur.user_id, ur.role_id, ur.assigned_at, u.username, r.code AS role_code, r.name AS role_name, r.description AS role_description, r.created_at AS role_created_at FROM iam_user_roles ur JOIN iam_users u ON u.id = ur.user_id JOIN iam_roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ur.assigned_at, ur.role_id
